title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：physics　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 physics 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the observer ① taught the physics that no assistant in the observatory would have counted, and he said the teaching was the whole of the night. The ② physics, meaning the science itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed uncounted in the book; physics, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of physics in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ physics at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Physics, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the observer said the counting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the physics was the whole of the matter, meaning the law and not the science. The ⑥ physics, meaning the law and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; physics, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both science and a law. He said the law is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ physics had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ physics of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of counting; physics, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ physics I remember is the physics counted in the log, which closed in 1978 and is still counted as the quietest in the observatory. ⑩ Physics, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all physics, she said, is a law that has agreed to look like science. She said the law was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 物理学（指观测站里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 物理学（指那门物理学本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the physics 教这一门物理学
D. n. 物理学（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 物理学之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的物理学之事）
F. n. 物理学（指观测记录里写到、被清点的那一门）
G. n. 物理学、定律（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 定律（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the physics that no assistant in the observatory would have counted
The physics, meaning the science itself and not the lens
Every sort of physics in that observatory
the physics at the far dome
the physics was the whole of the matter
the physics had become a line in a log
The physics of the whole thing

answers.why: teach the physics 意为“教这一门物理学”，1971 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯清点的一门物理学做了一遍。
physics 意为“物理学”，指那门物理学本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被清点。
physics 意为“物理学”，指观测站里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
physics 意为“物理学”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
physics 意为“物理学、定律”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门定律就是那件事的全部。
physics 意为“定律”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那门物理学，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
physics 意为“物理学”，指观测记录里写到、被清点的那一门，到 1976 年这一门成了观测记录里的一行。
physics 意为“物理学之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的物理学之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的清点。
physics 意为“物理学”，我记得的是观测记录里清点过的那一门，1978 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一门。
physics 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，物理学是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的物理学。
